major_cooldowns.name: Pillar of Frost
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use strictly on cooldown to multiply your strength and enter your primary burst window.

major_cooldowns.name: Empower Rune Weapon
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use with every second Pillar of Frost to flood your resources during burst.

major_cooldowns.name: Frostwyrm's Fury
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use at the very end of a Pillar of Frost window to benefit from the highest stacked strength multiplier.

major_cooldowns.name: Remorseless Winter
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown to maintain Gathering Storm and deal passive AoE damage.

defensives.name: Anti-Magic Shell
defensives.usage_rule: Use proactively to absorb magic damage and prevent application of magical debuffs.

defensives.name: Icebound Fortitude
defensives.usage_rule: Use to reduce all damage taken by 30% and immune stun effects.

defensives.name: Death Strike
defensives.usage_rule: Use as a Runic Power dump to heal after taking significant damage.

rules.description: Stack Pillar of Frost and ERW
rules.action: Always cast Empower Rune Weapon simultaneously with Pillar of Frost.
Cast Frostwyrm's Fury in the final 1-2 seconds of Pillar of Frost to snapshot the maximum strength buff.
Never cap Runic Power, and never let 3 or more Runes sit unused.
Cast Remorseless Winter on cooldown and spend runes while it is active to extend its duration via Gathering Storm.

source_summary: Frost Death Knight is an accelerating burst spec. Damage is heavily reliant on the 1-minute Pillar of Frost window, requiring the player to rapidly alternate Obliterate and Frost Strike to build strength, culminating in a massive Frostwyrm's Fury.
